items.markdown:
![Ring Settings | Eye For Gems](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-bd028a295616:15)
A diamond setting is the metal structure that holds a diamond in place on a ring.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-styles/)

### Popular Types of Diamond Settings

- **Prong Setting** : Slim metal arms (usually 4 or 6) cradle the diamond. It allows maximum light to enter the stone for high brilliance, but can catch on clothing.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u8dQXDqFVn0&t=7)[[4]](https://kravitjewelers.com/blogs/news/how-to-choose-a-diamond-ring-setting)
- **Bezel Setting** : A thin metal rim fully or partially wraps around the diamond's edge. It offers superior protection and a sleek, modern look, making it great for active lifestyles.[[1]](https://www.kesslersdiamonds.com/education/setting-types/)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)[[3]](https://kravitjewelers.com/blogs/news/how-to-choose-a-diamond-ring-setting)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ugA2aGAdwLE)
- **Pavé Setting** : Tiny accent diamonds are set closely together with small metal beads to create a continuous, paved sparkling surface.[[1]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)
- **Halo Setting** : A ring of smaller pavé diamonds surrounds a larger center stone. This makes the main diamond look significantly bigger and adds extra sparkle.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)
- **Channel Setting** : Diamonds are nestled side-by-side inside a recessed groove between two parallel metal walls. It has smooth edges that protect the stones and prevent snagging.[[1]](https://www.castinghouse.com/jewelry-manufacturing/diamonds-and-setting.html)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html)[[3]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings)[[4]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lowb6PCUzgo)
- **Tension Setting** : The diamond is held suspended in place entirely by the spring pressure of the metal band. It gives a unique floating look, but requires expert engineering and very hard stones.[[1]](https://kravitjewelers.com/blogs/news/how-to-choose-a-diamond-ring-setting)[[2]](https://www.kesslersdiamonds.com/education/setting-types/)[[3]](https://www.nfoxjewelers.com/page/setting-types.html)[[4]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)
- **Three-Stone Setting** : A central diamond is flanked by two smaller side stones. The trio traditionally symbolizes the past, present, and future.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/engagement-ring-insights/types-of-diamond-settings-how-to-choose-the-right-one-for-your-ring/)[[2]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings)

You can explore visual examples and educational guides at [Tiffany & Co.](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/ring-settings-styles.html) or read more detailed breakdowns on [Blue Nile](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings).[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/types-of-ring-settings)If you'd like, tell me:

- Are you shopping for an **engagement ring** or a **wedding band**?
- Is your priority **maximum sparkle** or **everyday durability**?

I can help you pick the best setting for your needs.
